profile.org_note: Family-owned and centralised: founder Itzhak (Itchko) Ezratti, his son President Misha Ezratti, COO Marcie DePlaza and CFO Maria Menendez sit at the Sunrise headquarters (1600 Sawgrass Corporate Parkway, Suite 400). Two named field units exist (West Coast Division under Patty Campbell; St. Lucie Operations under Ryan Courson); each community is run by a VP/Project Manager. Land is handled at corporate: VP of Land Larry Portnoy, with Misha Ezratti personally fronting land deals, and zoning and entitlement executives Kevin Ratterree, Dick Norwalk and Azlina Goldstein. No leadership page is published; titles come from the company's own news articles.
profile.summary: Florida-only private builder (1,617 closings on the 2026 Builder 100; the company calls itself the 8th largest private builder in the US), best known for Valencia 55+ communities and luxury Palm Beach County communities. It buys and holds large tracts itself rather than optioning lots: agricultural-reserve assemblages, master-plan parcels (192 acres in Westlake for $80M in January 2026, 42 Avenir homesites for $28.1M in April 2026) and closed golf courses (Calusa, Falls, and Polo West in Wellington under contract for $62.5M in November 2026). The Ezratti family controls the company and no outside land banker or capital partner is named in public sources.
